title: Stability-Aware Retargeting for Humanoid Multi-Contact Teleoperation
title_zh: 面向人形机器人多接触遥操作的稳定性感知重定向方法
abstract: Teleoperation is a powerful method to generate reference motions and enable humanoid robots to perform a broad range of tasks. However, teleoperation becomes challenging when using hand contacts and non-coplanar surfaces, often leading to motor torque saturation or loss of stability through slipping. We propose a centroidal stability-based retargeting method that dynamically adjusts contact points and posture during teleoperation to enhance stability in these difficult scenarios. Central to our approach is an efficient analytical calculation of the stability margin gradient. This gradient is used to identify scenarios for which stability is highly sensitive to teleoperation setpoints and inform the local adjustment of these setpoints. We validate the framework in simulation and hardware by teleoperating manipulation tasks on a humanoid, demonstrating increased stability margins. We also demonstrate empirically that higher stability margins correlate with improved impulse resilience and joint torque margin.
abstract_zh: 遥操作是生成参考运动并使人形机器人执行广泛任务的有力方法。然而，当使用手部接触和非共面表面时，遥操作变得具有挑战性，常常导致电机扭矩饱和或通过滑动失去稳定性。我们提出了一种基于质心稳定性的重定向方法，在遥操作过程中动态调整接触点和姿态，以增强这些困难场景中的稳定性。我们方法的核心是稳定性裕度梯度的高效解析计算。该梯度用于识别稳定性对遥操作设定点高度敏感的场景，并指导这些设定点的局部调整。我们通过在仿真和硬件上对人形机器人进行操作任务的遥操作来验证该框架，证明了稳定性裕度的提高。我们还通过实验表明，更高的稳定性裕度与改进的冲量弹性和关节扭矩裕度相关。
tldr_zh: 提出稳定性感知重定向方法，动态调整接触点与姿态，提升人形机器人遥操作稳定性。
cover_zh: 人形机器人遥操作总打滑？这个重定向方法让稳定性裕度直接提升
